items.summary: Manufacturing operations co-op supporting production processes at SABIC's Mt. Vernon, Indiana facility.

highlights: Facilitate weekly classes for 2 sections of 21 first-year engineering students, using lesson plans designed to support their academic, professional, and personal growth.
Create and deliver engaging, unique hour-long lesson plans that help students adjust to college life and develop key skills for success.
Provide one-on-one mentoring to monitor students' academic progress and well-being, offering guidance and resources as needed.
Practiced organization skills in stock management.
Learned to work autonomously and confidently, managing other employees' duties.
Built long-lasting relationships with coworkers and managers through teamwork and collaboration.
